header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there and says so), Start
Game, then Start (Enter) held 400 ms every 5 s through the legal screen, the logos, the title, New Game, the
difficulty, the Rumble Pak notice and the opening scene to the character choice, Danielle and her scene, into the
Breach, the first level, as a player does. The plan's waits are the browser's time: nothing tells it where the game
is, so a press that comes while the game loads waits for the next. The play is the Breach walked (the C buttons),
turned (the stick) and fired in for 25 s; --play 25 is that long in the level standing still.
